Did your idle ₹1 lakh just get smaller?

Retail inflation rose to 5.54% in September 2026, from 4.83% in August. Food inflation was 7.74%.
Illustrative: if prices rise 5.54% in a year, ₹1 lakh kept as cash buys only about ₹94,750 worth of today's things.
Keep an emergency fund, but check what the rest earns and compare it with inflation once a year.
